intro: Kazakh culture grew from nomadic life: horses, yurts, hospitality and music.

chapters.title: Nomad traditions
text: Hunting with golden eagles, horse games and the dombra, a two-stringed lute, are cherished. Guests are welcomed with tea and bread.

chapters.title: Food
text: Beshbarmak, boiled meat with noodles, is the national dish. Kumis (fermented mare's milk) is a traditional drink.
